title: Multi-agency protective action recommendation
description: A recommendation passed from the hazmat group to the incident commander and on to the county and the facility: the recommended action, the areas, who agrees, who disagrees and the decision. Distances are entered by the author or invented for a fictional material, and the source field says which.

agency.description: Agency or unit that keeps this record.

incidentName.description: Incident name as command announced it.
examples: Tank car leak at Harlan Spur

marking.description: Exercise marking printed at the top and bottom. Defaults to the standard exercise marking.

examples: Elm Street Elementary and homes west of Harlan Road

decision.description: What the incident commander decided, with the time.
examples: Incident commander kept shelter in place and ordered buses staged on the east side at 11:24.
Invented exercise distance for a fictional material. Players use their own guidebook for real decisions.
